title: Standard
description: Information about a particular standard that another item conforms to

created.title: creation date
created.description: The date on which the Standard has been first created

anyOf.description: A year and month in YYYY-MM format

_oldDocs.definition: This property contains the date on which the Standard has been first created.

description.title: description
description.description: A free-text account of the Standard

_oldDocs.definition: This property contains a free-text account of the Standard. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description - see Multilinguism

examples: Data Catalog Vocabulary - United States Profile version 3.0
The DCAT-US 3.0 schema defines a standard metadata format for data catalogs in the United States government, based on W3C DCAT.

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: The unique identifier for the Standard, e.g. the URI or other unique identifier in the context of the Catalog

_oldDocs.definition: This property contains the main identifier for the Standard, e.g. the URI or other unique identifier in the context of the Catalog, or of a reference register

otherIdentifier.title: other identifier
otherIdentifier.description: A list of identifiers for the Standard besides the main identifier, e.g. the URI or other unique identifiers in the context of the Catalog

issued.title: issued
issued.description: The date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the Standard

anyOf.description: A year and month in YYYY-MM format

_oldDocs.range: rdfs:Literal (typed as xsd:date, xsd:dateTime, xsd:gYear or xsd:gYearMonth)
_oldDocs.definition: This property contains the date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the Standard.

modified.title: last modified
modified.description: The most recent date on which the Standard was changed or modified

anyOf.description: A year and month in YYYY-MM format

_oldDocs.definition: This property contains the most recent date on which the Standard was changed or modified.

title.title: title
title.description: A name given to the Standard

_oldDocs.definition: This property contains a name given to the Standard. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name.

examples: DCAT-US 3.0 - Data Catalog Vocabulary United States Profile

category.title: category
category.description: List of categories for the Standard

inScheme.title: in scheme
inScheme.description: The reference register to which the Standard belongs

_oldDocs.definition: This property MAY be used to specify the reference register to which the Standard belongs.
A standard or other specification to which a Dataset or Distribution conforms.
_oldDocs.usageNote: A standard or other specification to which a Catalog, Catalog Record, Data Service, Dataset, or Distribution conforms
_oldDocs.rationale: The inclusion of dcterms:Standard in DCAT-US accommodates standard references through URLs or custom, detailed descriptions when specific standards are not available, promoting flexibility and completeness in resource metadata.

examples.description: Data Catalog Vocabulary - United States Profile version 3.0

inScheme.description: A collection of data standards used by federal agencies
